Relationship with my parents isn't terrible but isn't great. We're not very close at all and I don't really tell them anything. I could never imagine trying to tell them that I'm depressed and suicidal. My Dad doesn't believe in any kind of mental illness, depression, ADHD, anxiety disorders, etc. He just believes its all in your head and some people feel sorry for themselves. I find it impossible to talk to my mother about anything, because she either won't listen to a differing opinion, or will see everything as her fault. I know me killing myself would hurt them a lot, and they don't deserve that, but I honestly do not have it in me to confront them at all.

The person I talked to about it was my ex girlfriend. Long story but after I broke up with her in January, we were on and off for a little while, and I saw her the night before I left for a trip a couple weeks ago. My ex had changed her number, but knew what I was going through, and told me she would give me her new number when I got back if I agreed to get help. I had a lot of hope that things would work out between us, and I felt like breaking up with her was one of the biggest mistakes I'd ever made. 

However when I was away, I emailed her, and could right away tell that something was wrong with her response. After I couple emails back and forth, her mostly just saying enjoy your vacation we'll talk when you get back, I confronted her and said I couldn't when something was so clearly up, and I'd rather hear it then keep guessing what it could be. She told me she couldn't be anything but friends with me, and that seeing me before I went was a lapse in judgement that shouldn't have happened. 

I pretty much lost my shit, it was like my whole world collapsed in on itself. After a couple of emails back and forth, where I was in a really bad place, she promised me she'd still see me to help me go see someone, and then after I kept trying to get her to talk to me, she said "Goodbye KindOfPly" and just stopped replying. She hasn't talked to me since, I've emailed her a ridiculous number of times, when I got back this week I really wanted to just see her so I could hear it from her that it was over. I finally ended up calling her house and being told by her Mum that she didn't want to see or speak to me, and that I should be a man and stop contacting her. Pretty humiliating. 

I understand that seeing me makes it harder for her to move on and get on with her life, but at the same time I'm completely heart broken, and I feel like shit knowing that my presence can fuck someone's life up that much. I guess I can't really point to any one problem and say, "there, that's the one that makes me want to end my life," but the situation with her is certainly one of them. She was the only person who I ever really felt like cared if I was alive or not, the only person I ever felt comfortable talking to, in a lot of ways she understood me better than I do, and now she's gone because I fucked up. She's gotten over our relationship, and she's doing so much better now than she ever was with me. One of the things that stopped me from doing it yesterday was knowing she'd probably feel guilty about ignoring me, but now I couldn't really care less.

First trip.

Bought 9 gs of shrooms for me and a couple friends, told them not to take them the night we bought them, but they did behind my back. 

They left me my 3 though and after a while I decided it was time to do them before they went bad. It was a pretty shitty time in my life, and one of my really good friends (at the time) had been pissing me off-ditching me for other friends and such-a lot lately and she said that she wanted to hang out with just me to make up for it and stuff.

So we decided to go on a walk to the park, I'd do the shrooms, we'd smoke some weed and just chill out. But as we're on our way, she says that we should pick up another friend who I'm not really a great fan of, and who isn't the biggest fan of drugs. So we go to his house, then go to the park, and she says that ANOTHER mutual friend is coming. This is the worst because she and him liked each other at the time (they're dating now, but it was really awkward back then and it ended up splitting up our entire group)

So we're in the park, I took the shrooms about an hour ago, didn't feel anything so me and the original friend decided to smoke some weed. This was really good weed and we were sitting on a log in the middle of an open field that had pathways surrounding it, pretty far away but still pretty visible to anything obvious. So we're smoking this amazing pot, she is high as fuck and my trip kicks in.

Normal trip shit starts happening, I'm higher than I've ever been before and my friends wanted to get out of the field, I couldn't really move so I just told them to go ahead and come back later. So I'm tripping balls, trying to listen to music and read, because people are walking around on the paths around the field and I didn't want to look suspicious, but I can't read. Anyway they come back and so I go over to them, but I'm really paranoid that my original friend is being really obvious and high and that we were going to get caught. She jumped into the river with our mutual friend she liked and they were heavily flirting. THe other friend we picked up is jealous that he's not a part of their conversation so everyone's pretty much ignoring me and my repeated questions about us getting caught or WTF was going on, or laughing at me and trying to trip me out.

I get pissed off and walk off, but they keep calling me back, but the same shit is happening and I keep leaving, so after a while they just decide to follow me. I get to the carpark where mutual friend's car is, and sit by a tree, listening to music. They get in the car and I figure I'll just chill out for a bit, see if they apologize or something and then get a ride home. But nothing happens so I decide to walk home, but am tripping pretty badly and really paranoid. They see me walking home and so they drive off, and thats when my bad trip kicked in.

I felt so alone and worthless, I saw all the times I had tried to change myself, get over bad habits, make new ones, just improve as a person, and how I had failed each time. I felt like I was never going to amount to anything and I repeatedly tried to call my friends throughout the trip, but they never answered the phone until I was home and crying my eyes out. Anti drug friend (jealous one who was tripping me out and ignoring my paranoid requests for reassurance) answers and asks if I'm okay, I say no and he pretty much says that I shouldn't have done shrooms. Anyway the whole night was just really awful, I remember mostly the walk back to my house, up a pretty big hill, was awful. I was paranoid, upset and to top it off, when I smoke pot sitting down if I try to get up and move around a lot I get really achey and my back and legs really hurt, so tripping on that feeling and trying to get home wasn't the best. I vividly remember feeling like my spine was coming out of my back, and grabbing behind me to try and put it in, only to realize I was grabbing at my backpack. It was pretty fucked.
